hero_subtitle: A completely free, offline‑first loyalty engine that lives in your customers' Apple Wallet. No fees, no accounts, no monthly bills, and no internet required after initial setup.
feature_sec_title: Built to Keep Customers Coming Back
feature_sec_sub: No hardware, no monthly fees. Set your own rewards, automate gentle reminders, and turn every visit into a lasting relationship.
feature_card1_item1: Personal Wallet Card: Display your store name proudly as a native card in the user's Wallet.
feature_card1_item2: Custom Stamps: Let your brand shine. Select the exact stamp style you want to show in the app.
feature_card1_item3: Win Back Inactives: Automated, gentle local notifications remind customers to visit if they've been away too long.
feature_card2_item1: You Set the Rules: Total freedom to define your own rewards (e.g., "10th Coffee Free"). We enforce nothing.
feature_card2_item2: 3 Security Modes: Choose between Basic, Simple, or Secure modes to match your store's pace and fraud-prevention needs.
feature_card2_item3: Location Perks: Geofencing triggers nearby alerts or bonus stamps during happy hour to drive foot traffic.
feature_card3_item1: Batch Printing: Print a single static QR code, or generate the next 7 days' worth of rotating codes for higher security.
feature_card3_item2: Instant Backup & Restore: Download your store's configuration file. If you ever switch devices or clear your browser, just upload it to restore everything instantly.
feature_card3_item3: Zero Hardware Required: Run everything from your existing phone, tablet, or POS web browser.
pricing_sub: We believe loyalty tools should empower small businesses, not tax them.

hint_opening_time: Alerts customers when you open for the day. Clear if unwanted.
hint_gps_location: Sends nearby customers a lockscreen alert and prevents stamps from being earned outside your store.
hint_display_name: What will display on the customers card. Max 20 characters.
hint_reward_desc: Max 30 characters (e.g., Free drinks after 8 stamps).
hint_happy_hour: Double the stamps during happy hour. Clear both fields to turn off.
hint_remind_days: Bring customers back with a reminder after this many days (Max 365).
sec_desc_basic: Low security – Customers can only stamp once per day. Your QR code never changes, so you print it once and use it forever. No date, location, or signature checks. Best for low-traffic areas where fraud is not a concern.
sec_desc_simple: Medium security – Customers can only stamp once per day. QR codes expire daily and require customers to be physically near your store to stamp. Prevents old QR reuse and screenshot sharing. Requires refreshing the QR code daily (refresh the page or print fresh). Recommended for most stores.
sec_desc_secure: High security – All the protection of Simple mode, plus cryptographic signing that prevents QR tampering and forgery. The app cryptographically verifies every scan against your stores private key. Requires refreshing the QR code daily (refresh the page or print fresh). Perfect for busy, high-value stores where fraud prevention is critical.
inspiration_sub: Ideas for displaying your QR code around your store to turn walk-ins into repeat regulars. Leave the complex tech behind and focus on visibility.
isp_1_desc: Sidewalk A-Frame signs & front glass door decals to capture foot traffic before entry.
isp_2_desc: Front counter acrylics & digital POS overhead displays to capture impulse scans.
isp_3_desc: Table tents & lounge coffee table stands for relaxed scans during the visit.
isp_4_desc: Acrylic standees on partition shelves or waiting areas to maximize visibility.
privacy_section1_body: Vouchr’s Store Builder is designed to respect your privacy. We do not require you to create an account, nor do we collect your name, email address, phone number, or any other personal identifier. No data is ever transmitted to our servers. There is no backend – the entire tool runs locally in your browser.
privacy_section2_body: All store data – including your store name, reward description, opening time, GPS coordinates, and your Ed25519 private key – is stored exclusively in your browser’s localStorage. The QR code you generate is encoded on your device; no copy of your private key or store data is ever sent to the internet. The tool works offline after the first visit.
privacy_section3_body: If you choose to provide your store’s GPS coordinates (by typing them manually or clicking the “Locate” button), those coordinates are stored only in your browser’s localStorage. They are then embedded in the QR payload so that customers can receive nearby alerts. If you choose to use this feature, you agree to these conditions.
privacy_section4_body: Vouchr is a neutral tool. As a store owner, you set your own reward description (e.g., “Free coffee after 8 stamps”) and decide what reward to give. We do not enforce, guarantee, or mediate reward redemption. Any dispute regarding a reward is strictly between you and your customer. By using the Store Builder, you acknowledge that we are not responsible for the fulfilment of any reward.
privacy_section5_body: The Store Builder loads external resources (Bootstrap, Bootstrap Icons, and the QR generation library) from CDNs. These requests are standard for web applications and do not involve any data exchange beyond loading the necessary files. We do not use any analytics or advertising services.
privacy_section6_body: Because all data is stored locally in your browser, you can delete it at any time by clearing your browser’s localStorage (via browser settings or developer tools). We have no access to your data and cannot retrieve it on your behalf.
privacy_section7_body: Because we collect no personal information, there is no data to delete, disclose, or sell. If you are a California resident, you can be confident that no sale or sharing of personal information occurs.
privacy_contact_body: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, you may contact us at: develop@pocketenginestudio.com
